journey.title: A first useful plan
journey.purpose: Take a new person from diet and kitchen choices to one recommended meal and an inspectable draft week without demanding personal measurements just to start.

steps.intent: Choose a diet approach, composable exclusions, and the appliances I actually have.
See the summarized rules and how many stored meals currently fit them before applying.
Confirm there are meals I can actually cook and save a favorite with just a name.
Read one recommended meal with a calculation-backed reason and honest unknowns.
Inspect the generated draft week and confirm the accepted anchors are present.

claims.statement: A first plan is reachable without entering personal measurements, and incomplete data is described rather than hidden behind a coverage badge.
Finishing setup leads directly to one recommended meal and an inspectable week rather than an empty shell.
